description: Codex: Orks (11e) CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA (War Horde) through the real unit_selected_to_shoot WINDOW. Fixture ork11e_orks_active (P1 Orks War Horde active). Setup-only: Custodian Guard C is moved ~15" in front of the Trukk (inside half range of its 36" dual big shoota) and the Custodes defender auto-allocates wounds. A real click on the Trukk's token selects it to shoot; the StratagemDialog opens with the CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA card and an enabled 'Use on Trukk' button while every other phase action is refused. A real click on Use spends 1 CP, flags the Trukk and resumes the selection; the forecast now shows [RAPID FIRE 5] (the dual big shoota's own RAPID FIRE 4 +1). The shot is then declared and resolved through the real Quick-Assign, Confirm and dock Fast buttons, and the hit roll in the dice log reports rapid_fire_value 5 with +5 attack dice (one bearer in half range).

steps.comment: phase entry auto-selects the first eligible shooter as a REAL SELECT_SHOOTER (r5:F3): the phase and the panel agree on the active shooter

LV-2: the phase-entry auto-selection is not a player choice, so it opens NO unit_selected_to_shoot window (it opens before the player's first action with that shooter instead) - nothing to decline before the scenario picks its own shooter

steps.script:
var s = StratagemManager.get_stratagem("faction_ork_war_horde_close_range_dakka")
return s.get("implemented", false) and s.get("csv_id", "") == "close-range-dakka-war-horde"

steps.equals: Offered automatically when one of your units is selected to shoot
Trukk has been selected to shoot

steps.script:
var fc = tree.root.get_node("Main").shooting_controller._calc_weapon_expected_damage("dual_big_shoota_ranged", "U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C")
return ("Close-Range Dakka" in fc.get("active_tags", [])) and ("Rapid Fire 5" in fc.get("active_tags", []))

steps.comment: r1:WH-9: the weapon row shows the granted RAPID FIRE (RF5 = its own RAPID FIRE 4 + 1), not RF4
r1:WH-9: the dashed half-range circle carries the granted RAPID FIRE too
r1:WH-9: against a target beyond half range the forecast no longer counts the RAPID FIRE attacks (tagged 'out of half range')
